description.value:
Through the vagaries of fate, your own study of the supernatural, or other circumstances you have come into contact with a mystical force or great entity whom you are sworn to serve. As a proxy and teacher, you are provided with a constant companion in the form of a bonded familiar.

This familiar takes the form of a beast, celestial, elemental, fiend, plant, or undead of CR 0, which you choose. It uses the corresponding statblock of the creature, but uses your proficiency bonus and mental ability scores in place of its own. In addition to its own, it also shares your saving throw proficiencies and any of your skill proficiencies that use Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. For each level in this class, it also gains 4 additional hit points. When you finish a Short or Long Rest, your bonded familiar regains all its hit points.

Your bonded familiar can understand and speak all languages you speak. While it is on the same plane of existence as you, you can communicate with it telepathically.

Your bonded familiar acts independently of you, but it always obeys your commands. In combat, it rolls its own initiative and acts on its own turn.

As a Bonus Action, you can shunt your bonded familiar into a safe pocket dimension. You can recall it to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you in the same manner.

Should your bonded familiar die, you can resummon it with a special ritual that takes 10 minutes. Alternatively, you can resummon it as an Action by spending a spell slot of 1st level or higher.
